<thought>
The goal 'G' is visible a few cells ahead and to the right. Immediately in front of me is a floor cell, so moving forward is safe. Since the most direct path toward 'G' is likely by moving ahead and then navigating around the lava, my first step should be to move forward.
</thought>
<action>
MOVE_FORWARD
</action>

<thought>
I am now one cell forward from my previous position. Directly in front of me are lava cells, so moving forward is unsafe. To approach the goal, I need to change my orientation. Turning right will face me toward the free path leading to the goal.
</thought>
<action>
TURN_RIGHT
</action>

<thought>
Now I am facing a corridor where directly ahead is a safe floor cell. The goal 'G' is two cells forward and one cell to the left from my current position. Advancing forward will bring me closer to the goal and keep me on a safe path.
</thought>
<action>
MOVE_FORWARD
</action>
